positions.restorationism: material certified against the long-standing archival standard RS-4 should be foregrounded ahead of material migrated to the current revision RS-9, even where the migrated material scores better on present-day metrics
positions.continuationism: material migrated to the current archival standard RS-9 should be foregrounded ahead of material still certified against the older RS-4, even where the older certification has the longer track record
